about.metaDescription: Dayront processes your files entirely in your browser. No uploads, no servers, just fast and private media tools.
about.heading: About Dayront
paragraphs: Dayront is a collection of free, online media tools that run 100% in your browser. We never upload your files to any server. Everything stays on your device.
Built with privacy and speed as core principles, Dayront uses modern web technologies like FFmpeg.wasm to process audio and video locally. No software installation required.
Our mission: make powerful media editing accessible to everyone, without compromising your data.

terms.metaDescription: Terms of service for using Dayront's free online media tools.
terms.heading: Terms of Service

sections.body: By accessing or using Dayront, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please do not use the service.

sections.title: Description of Service
sections.body: Dayront provides browser-based media conversion and editing tools. All processing is performed locally on your device. We do not have access to your files.

sections.title: User Responsibilities

privacy.metaDescription: Dayront's privacy policy: your files never leave your device. Read how we protect your data.
privacy.heading: Privacy Policy

sections.title: Your Files Stay on Your Device
sections.body: All conversions and edits are performed inside your browser using WebAssembly. We do not upload, store, or view your files. Ever.

sections.title: Data We Collect
sections.body: We may use anonymous analytics (without cookies) to understand how our tools are used. No personal data is collected.

sections.title: Advertisements
sections.body: Advertisements may be displayed via third‑party networks that could use cookies. Please refer to their respective privacy policies for more information.

sections.title: Contact Us
sections.body: If you have questions about this policy, please contact us at privacy@dayront.com.
